title: Burisch and his wife's strange vlogs

tellings.quote: when I was hanging out with with Chris Ramsey, he showed me the most bizarre videos of um Dan Barish and his wife

plain: An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb says that while spending time with Chris Ramsay, another figure who makes videos about these topics, Ramsay showed him some very odd videos. According to UAPGerb, the videos were personal video diaries made by a man named Dan Burisch and his wife, and he calls them the most bizarre he has seen.
